recipe.selection_rule: English Wikipedia, all-access, user agent class, chosen ex ante; no article popularity selection
recipe.transformation: API daily total views; one serialized identifiable User-Agent request; absent days remain missing, never zero-filled.

recipe.selection_rule: Global_active_power only, full documented source interval chosen ex ante; partial endpoint hours remain missing
recipe.timezone_assumption: Original source timezone not certified; interpret wall-clock timestamps as UTC, without DST conversion
recipe.transformation: Mean Global_active_power in kW for exactly 60 distinct observed, valid minutes per hour. Missing tokens ? or empty, absent or duplicate minutes remain explicit; no imputation, no kWh claim. Per-hour sample counts retained.

recipe.selection_rule: All item codes and countries, chosen ex ante; no ranking or filtering by final scores
recipe.timezone_assumption: Original source timezone not certified; interpret wall-clock timestamps as UTC, without DST conversion
recipe.transformation: Daily sum of strictly positive non-cancelled Quantity. Invoice/InvoiceNo starts C or negative Quantity goes to a separate positive-magnitude returns series. Zero Quantity ignored. Empty transaction days have zero activity, not missing values. No customer/description fields are needed.

scenarios.description: Illustrative external deliveries scenario; no observed realization binding and excluded from benchmark scores
